parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-opus-5',
  max_tokens: 16000,
  system: 'You write 15 to 22 second vertical reels for a local business, as a plan the render worker executes. Reply with JSON only, matching the schema in the user message. Rules: one idea per scene; hook in the first line; every claim must appear in the client config or the posts; never invent a review, a price or a result; never mention Project Driver; close on the client phone number; keep each line under 9 words; pick the format that has not run most recently.',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'CLIENT CONFIG:
' + JSON.stringify($("Client config").item.json) + '

RECENT POSTS (captions and media):
' + JSON.stringify($("Recent posts (HighLevel)").item.json.results?.posts?.map(p => ({date: p.publishedAt, platform: p.platform, summary: p.summary, media: p.media?.map(m => m.url)})) ) + '

MEDIA LIBRARY (files you may use as src, by url):
' + JSON.stringify($("Media library (HighLevel)").item.json.files?.map(f => ({name: f.name, url: f.url, type: f.contentType, w: f.width, h: f.height}))) + '

SCHEMA: {"id": string, "format": string, "seconds": number, "client": {short,name,phone,area,brand,close,ghlLocationId}, "script": string (the full read, one sentence per phrase, separated by blank lines), "phrases": [{"text": string, "at": seconds}], "musicPrompt": string, "caption": string (post caption with hashtags), "scenes": [{"type": "clip"|"image"|"stats"|"end", "src"?: url, "start"?: seconds, "zoom"?: number, "position"?: css object-position, "fit"?: "cover"|"contain", "from": seconds, "to": seconds, "lines"?: [{"at": seconds from scene start, "hold": seconds, "text": string, "size"?: number, "accent"?: boolean}], "items"?: [{"big": string, "small": string}]}]}. The last scene is type end. Phrase at-times must fall inside the scene that shows that line.'}]
}) }}

nodes.name: Write the plan (Claude API)
nodes.notes: Header auth credential: x-api-key = Anthropic API key. The reply is the plan JSON.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ref: 'main', inputs: {plan: JSON.stringify($json.plan), plan_id: $json.plan_id, upload: true}}) }}
